This plot is small and rented, so I will manage it carefully and keep my costs low. I intercrop it, and for tubers I usually depend more on family work and any manure or compost I can get nearby than on expensive chemical fertilizer. I will plant the seed I know well, work mostly with rain, and only bring in a little hired help when the work is heavy.
